reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' and the cited text supports it: p0037 and p0042 are Internet-project exclusivity covenants concerning Deerskin Products, not restrictions on soliciting, hiring or inducing either party's employees, so no non-solicit or no-hire is imposed on us as Customer (the Company).

Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment is proposed; the rendered paragraphs are byte-identical to the originals, which is the correct outcome under the preferred position ('No non-solicit on Customer').

The failed deterministic checks (12-month duration, general-solicitation carve-out) are expected artifacts of clause absence rather than evidence of a defect — there is no non-solicit clause in which a duration or carve-out could appear.

The rationale appropriately flags the p0037 exclusivity restriction on us as a separate competition/exclusivity issue outside NOSOLICIT scope, so the deal team is not left unaware of the restriction while keeping this rule's analysis accurate.
